description: Develop an e-commerce platform that allows users to browse products, add items to a shopping cart, and complete purchases.
vision: To create a user-friendly online store that enables seamless product browsing, adding to the cart, and checkout processes, ensuring a secure and efficient transaction experience for both buyers and sellers.

features.name: Product Catalog
features.description: A searchable and filterable list of products available for purchase.

features.name: Shopping Cart
features.description: A feature that allows users to add, remove, and modify items in their cart before checking out.

features.name: User Authentication & Profiles
features.description: Allow users to create accounts, log in, manage personal information, and save preferences.

features.name: Payment Gateway Integration
features.description: Integrate with a secure payment gateway for transactions.

features.name: Order Management System
features.description: Enable merchants to view and manage orders, including shipping information and order status updates.

user_stories.i_want: to browse products based on categories and price ranges
user_stories.so_that: I can find the products I am interested in quickly.

user_stories.i_want: to add items to my shopping cart and modify quantities
user_stories.so_that: I can easily manage the products I want to purchase.
acceptance_criteria: Quantities can be changed in the cart

user_stories.i_want: to view a summary of my shopping cart before checking out
user_stories.so_that: I can verify the items and quantities before proceeding to payment.
acceptance_criteria: Option to remove or modify items

user_stories.i_want: to view orders placed by consumers
user_stories.so_that: I can process deliveries and provide customer support.

non_functional_requirements.performance: The system should handle a minimum of 10,000 concurrent users without significant performance degradation. Response time for product listings and cart operations should not exceed 3 seconds.
non_functional_requirements.security: Data transmitted between client and server must be encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher. User passwords must be stored securely using hashing algorithms.
non_functional_requirements.scalability: The application should support at least 50,000 products and 5,000 active users simultaneously without performance issues.
non_functional_requirements.availability: System availability should be at least 99.9% with minimal downtime.

constraints: Must integrate with existing payment gateway API
Compliance with GDPR regulations for user data protection
assumptions: Development team has expertise in e-commerce and web development
Budget includes necessary hosting and maintenance costs
